inside-fridges.title: Inside the fridges
inside-fridges.description: Remove the drawers. Clean the floor and walls, including the inside of the door.

plastic-boxes.title: Plastic box storage area
plastic-boxes.description: Remove the boxes. Clean the area with degreaser, soap and water.

oven-area.title: Around the oven
oven-area.description: Remove spare items and lids. Clean the gastronorm tray and the top of the oven.

storage.title: Clean and organize the storeroom
storage.description: Clear the window area. Clean with soap and water, dry it, and set aside unused items.

under-sink.title: Under the sink
under-sink.description: Check that everything is dry and in its place.

inside-extraction-bell.title: Inside the extraction hood
inside-extraction-bell.description: Remove the cover and apply degreaser throughout, including around the extraction duct.

behind-fridges.title: Behind the fridges and freezer
behind-fridges.description: Move the fridges. Sweep the area and clean the black panels and any built-up dirt.

inside-oven.title: Oven interior and door
inside-oven.description: Remove the metal rails. Clean the walls and floor with soap and water, and remove crumbs from the door.

induction-stoves.title: Behind and below the induction hob
induction-stoves.description: Degrease the fan area and underside. Clean the filters.

dishwasher.title: Dishwasher door and interior
dishwasher.description: Drain the water, scrub the walls and clean beneath the metal parts by hand. Run a cycle and clean the seal.
